sentences.text:
Smt. Ushabai vs Chandreshwar on 13 September, 2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:27249
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Indore

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh

On The 13th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Appeal No. 1929 of 2014
 Smt. Ushabai And Others
 Versus
 Chandreshwar And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Sanjay Patwa - Advocate for the appellants.
 Shri Bhashkar Agrawal - Advocate for the respondent N
 Order

This misc. appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1983 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 18.06.2014 in claim case No.155/2012 passed by Additional 14th Member of M.A.C.T. Indore for enhancement of compensation of Rs.3,00,000/-.

2. The only controversy in this appeal is that in a claim petition filed under Section 166(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 seeking compensation of Rs.12,00,000/- only Rs.4,67,000/- has been awarded in which death of Nitish aged 21 years and studied upto Class 11th, raising the income of Rs.4,000/- per month.
3. Challenge to the award is on the ground that income ought to have been assessed Rs.5,000/- per month and amount in the head of loss of consortium ought to have been granted.

4. Counsel for the respondent has opposed the application referring NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:27249 2 MA-1929-2014 to para 10 of the award that no proof of Rs.5,000/- per month income has been brought on record and the loss of dependency has been adequately compensated.
Heard and perused the record.
5. Tribunal have not relied on the certificate Ex.P-10 issued by Citizen Associates, Indore certifying that deceased was working as a merchandiser and was paid Rs.5,000/- per month.

6. This certificate has been discarded on the ground that issuing authority has not been examined but on record there is evidence of co- employee Hitesh PW-3 who has supported the version of Smt. Ushabai vs Chandreshwar on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186075286/
1 parents of the deceased regarding the income from the job of Nitesh.
7. Now, we are examining the matter on another angle i.e educational certificate Ex.P-11 to Ex.P-20 on record.

Ex.P-11 discloses that date of birth of the deceased was 18.09.1989, Ex.P-12 discloses that deceased cleared his matriculation examination in first division from Bhartiya Shiksha Parishad U.P. and he was associated with Coal Group as apprentice vide Ex.P-13 and he participated in extra curricular activities and was applicant for the post of Police Constable vide Ex.P-16 but due to death these efforts got ruined.

In the light of this material claim of the petitioners regarding Rs.5,000/-
per month income is justified and 40% future prospect is also justified.
Accordingly, loss of dependency is re

8. Tribunal has awarded Rs.4,32,000/- in the head of loss of dependency accordingly,
R s . 3 , 2 4 , 0 0 0 / - i s e n h a n c e d i n t h e h e a d o f l o s s o f N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N N O .
2024:MPHC-IND:27249 3 MA-1929-2014 dependency.
Rs.80,000/- is awarded in the head of loss of consortium but appellant No.1 & 2 brothers of the deceased are not entitled for loss of consortium.

With the aforesaid, this misc. appeal is allowed and total compensation of Rs.4,04,000/- (Four lac four thousand only) is further enhanced with interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the date of application ie 26.07.2012 .
The enhanced amount be satisfied and distributed as per para 15 of the award of Tribunal.

9. The appellants have valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.3,00,000/- and paid the Court fee accordingly, however, for the remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellants within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
10. Accordingly, this misc appeal is disposed of.
Pending I.As if any, shall stand closed.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE akanksha Smt. Ushabai vs Chandreshwar on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186075286/
